title: Deeper/broader DWG/DXF peer lineage and semantic-stage review
mode: primary-source peer review and read-only local-code audit; plan-only
scope: Reconcile LibreDWG fixed-type labels with its current reported AcDs/SAB boundaries
Distinguish ACadRust synthetic and self-roundtrip tests from independent semantic evidence
Refresh OpenCADStudio's current mutable source dependency identity without equating it to a released binary
Audit ezdxf raw ACIS inspection versus rendering and semantic scope
Use ACadSharp's reported nested-block solid loss as a local inventory-control design lead
Reconcile Autodesk AcDbSun's hard-owner classes with the VIEW DXF group-361 schema
Separate stock FreeCAD converter/importer qualification from the optional InventorLoader SAT/SAB consumer route and refresh current public issue reports
Map peer boundaries to the existing libdxfrw DWG, AcDs, DXF SAT/SAB, adapter, and semantic routes

method.kind: Read-only review of primary project source/documentation and local implementation
method.limitations: The reviewed GitHub main/master pages are mutable. OpenCADStudio's current manifest pins source dependencies, but this pass did not resolve a matching released binary/lockfile, compare opencadcodec source against canonical ACadRust, build or run any peer, or inspect a DWG/DXF payload through an external implementation. ACadSharp and LibreDWG issue reports remain peer-reported outcomes for their stated builds.

sources.revision: Mutable master schema/news and issue #1411 as viewed 2026-10-18; issue-reported build 0.14.8593 at 8a1ae764
sources.observed: The current object schema labels 3DSOLID fixed-type support STABLE. Project history and issue #1411 separately report incomplete R2013+ AcDs/SAB behavior; #1411 reports loss of a 5,489-byte SAB record while an AC1032 REGION shell survives. This is not an independently reproduced current-main result.

sources.revision: Mutable main/README, package version advertised as 0.6.4, viewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The README advertises broad DWG/DXF and ACIS modeling coverage. Roundtrip tests include same-implementation writer-reader checks, locally constructed planar geometry, and a fabricated marker-bearing SAB helper. These are internal regression evidence, not an independent parser, kernel, or native-acceptance result.

sources.revision: Mutable main manifest/README and public release index viewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The main manifest aliases package acadrust as codec from HakanSeven12/opencadcodec at revision 12d68e4 and pins HakanSeven12/opencadkernel at 80a8a26; the README advertises DWG/DXF and 3D application functionality. These mutable source pins do not identify a tested release binary or resolve a full release dependency lock. The current codec source overlap with canonical ACadRust was not audited.

The project documents ACIS-related DXF operations and raw SAT/SAB browsing, while its drawing add-on documents no ACIS rendering and no 3D rendering engine. This supports carrier inspection, not complete B-rep semantics or DWG AcDs ownership.

sources.revision: Open issue #1195, peer-reported ACadSharp 3.4.9 behavior, viewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The report describes silent DWG-to-DXF omission of 3DSOLID/REGION, including block-nested entities. The issue was not reproduced and is used only to sharpen complete source-handle/output-disposition checks.

sources.project: FreeCAD stock DXF importer and optional InventorLoader route
sources.revision: Mutable public documentation/source viewed 2026-10-18; InventorLoader issues #102/#103/#110 are open on the issue pages. Issue #109 concerns native IPT feature import and is explicitly excluded from DXF/SAT/SAB evidence.
sources.observed: FreeCAD documentation and issue #18454 state that stock DXF import does not consume embedded ACIS solids, so a DWG converter producing DXF does not establish solid consumption. The optional InventorLoader DXF wrapper separately uses ezdxf to extract each entity's SAT/SAB and passes the payload to its own reader before FreeCAD/OCCT shape construction; its README lists unsupported surface classes. Issue #102 reports SAB conversion failure on an attached model, #103 reports no face recognized for a SAT sample, and #110 describes a SAT reader-state problem with a user-provided workaround and remaining face-normal concerns. These are reporter-scoped observations; the workaround is not a pinned independent pass and no issue payload was downloaded or run.

sources.revision: Autodesk ObjectARX 2027 and DXF references 2024, viewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: AcDbSun documentation identifies AcDbViewportTableRecord and AcDbViewport as hard-owner classes and documents the viewport setSun/sunId API. The VIEW DXF schema also lists group 361, creating a contract tension for AcDbViewTableRecord ownership. The plan keeps VIEW 361 fail-closed pending producer/authoritative reconciliation and treats Skylight code 340 as a separate reference from the hard owner.

sources.revision: Working tree at baseline commit de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9 plus current uncommitted edits, audited 2026-10-18
sources.observed: dwgreader.cpp separates modeler parsing from DataStorage association and only normalizes qualified REGION/3DSOLID records after unique handle-linked SAB signature selection; BODY remains outside that proven external-carrier mapping. drw_acis.h documents a bounded wireframe/projection reader with unsupported-node accounting rather than a complete kernel. This is a source audit, not a complete runtime qualification.

assessment.planImpact: Refines the existing peer-lineage, source-to-output inventory, ACIS/AcDs semantic, composed consumer, and PAR-40 SUN-owner gates. Distinguishes mutable application manifests from released binaries, current fixed-type recognition from AcDs payload closure, raw carrier checks from complete shape operations, stock FreeCAD conversion/import from optional plug-in consumption, and documented VPORT/VIEWPORT SUN ownership from the unresolved VIEW group-361 contract. Local PAR-40/7G.2 work remains independent of optional peer availability.

implementationReadyChecks: Keep DWG entity parsing, AcDs section decode, entity-to-record association, DXF SAT/SAB carrier retention, payload parse completeness, semantic body validity, operations, and native acceptance as separate status fields.

For the next SUN graph slice, allow only one matching VPORT or VIEWPORT hard owner per SUN; retain fail-closed behavior for VIEW 361 and Skylight-to-SUN until their separate contract edges are resolved.

Before using OpenCADStudio as evidence, bind the exact app release/source commit, resolved lockfile, codec and kernel commits, operating system and architecture, input profile, and tested operation; do not map mutable-main dependencies onto a released artifact.

Keep stock FreeCAD converter-to-DXF-import evidence separate from InventorLoader's ezdxf-to-SAT/SAB-reader-to-OCCT path; an open add-on issue is a route-readiness warning, not proof of universal failure.

Treat OpenCADStudio and ACadRust as related codec evidence until a source-level overlap audit establishes any independent implementation. A separate UI/renderer is a consumer stage, not a second parser vote.
At the composed peer gate, record every source entity handle across modelspace, layouts, and nested blocks with carrier hash/chunk inventory, owner join, output disposition, and diagnostics.
Use locally authored small asymmetric controls and independent analytic expectations; same-codec round trips and synthetic marker payloads establish internal consistency only.

A missing required body, unjoined carrier, unsupported required topology, explicit incomplete marker, or fallback-only display is not a semantic pass; prefer atomic refusal over successful-looking loss.
Continue fast touched-target builds and focused generated tests per implementation slice; keep peer/native runs and full suites at the existing composed checkpoints.
Do not add peer-derived fixtures, dependencies, CTest entries, or per-slice peer work from this review.
Do not promote J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, or J295 without their specific external/platform qualification and independent semantic evidence.
